name: linear-regression
description: Performs univariate or multivariate Linear Regression trained using standard Gradient Descent.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to fit a linear model predicting numerical target outcomes from multi-dimensional features inputs.

parameters.name: learningRate
parameters.description: Speed scale constant of gradient descent adjustments (defaults to 0.01).

parameters.name: epochs
parameters.description: Number of training iterations loops (defaults to 1000).
